headline: Newsom commutes California death-row sentences
deck: The governor says all 548 people on the state’s death row will receive life without the possibility of parole.
body: Governor Gavin Newsom announced that he will commute the death sentences of all 548 people on California’s death row. The BBC reported that the action changes the sentences to life in prison, and KQED reported that they will become life without the possibility of parole. [E1] [E2]

In an open letter to Californians, Newsom wrote that state-sanctioned killing was incompatible with California’s values, undermined the foundations of the legal system and diminished each person, the Equal Justice Initiative reported. [E3]
